deep_dive.title: CovR: Coverage-Aware Hardware Verification via Reasoning-Guided Reinforcement Learning
deep_dive.abstract: Design verification remains one of the most resource-intensive stages of hardware development, often consuming up to 70% of the total design effort. While recent work has explored using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate testbench generation, most existing approaches focus narrowly on functional correctness, overlooking the critical aspect of coverage quality. To bridge this gap, we present CovR, an agentic framework for automated testbench generation that combines self-reflection loops with simulation-based feedback to maximize coverage. Using this pipeline, we construct a large-scale dataset of 16,514 natural specification RTL reasoning testbench tuples with a strong teacher model, enabling coverage-aware supervision. Building on this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for coverage-driven testbench generation, leveraging tool-derived rewards from simulation and coverage feedback to optimize a student model. Experimental results show that the CovR finetuned model achieves 93.81% cov@10 on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0, and 87.76% cov@10 on CVDP, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 7.97% and 3.59%, respectively. Furthermore, deploying the finetuned model back into the agentic refinement pipeline further improves cov@10 to 94.27% on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0 and 91.39% on CVDP. Moreover, when integrated as a plug-in stimulus engine for full verification workflows, CovR improves coverage by 18.95% and mutation detection score by 1.19%, while revealing 4.46% undetected failures, highlighting the importance of optimizing for coverage in LLM-based hardware verification.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: CovR is an agentic framework for automated testbench generation that combines self-reflection loops with simulation-based feedback to maximise coverage, building a 16,514-tuple coverage-aware dataset with a strong teacher model.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对设计验证耗费大量资源、而现有LLM测试台生成仅关注功能正确性、忽视覆盖率的问题，本文提出智能体式框架CovR。该方法将自反思循环与基于仿真的反馈相结合，以覆盖率最大化为目标自动生成测试台，并用强教师模型构建了16,514条自然规格-RTL推理-测试台元组以提供覆盖率感知监督。该工作把强化学习与仿真反馈引入硬件验证流程，为覆盖率导向的自动化验证提供了新路径。
